test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man can row at 9 km/h in still water. It takes him equal time to go 33 km downstream and to go 21 km upstream. Find the speed of the stream (in km/h).
solution:
Given:

In still water, speed = 9 km/h.

Time for 33 km downstream = Time for 21 km upstream

Concept used:

Upstream speed = (B - R) km/h

Downstream speed = (B + R) km/h

Where, B = Speed of the boat in still water

R = Speed of the stream

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Let the speed of the stream be R km/h.

Upstream speed = (9 - R) km/h

Downstream speed = (9 + R) km/h

According to the question,

33/(9 + R) = 21/(9 - R)

⇒ 11/(9 + R) = 7/(9 - R)

⇒ 63 + 7R = 99 - 11R

⇒ 18R = 36

⇒ R = 36/18

⇒ R = 2

∴ The speed of the stream is 2 km/h.
